content:
There are 6 houses, numbered 1 to 6 from left to right, as seen from across the street. Each house is occupied by a different person. Each house has a unique attribute for each of the following characteristics:
 - Each person has a unique name: `Arnold`, `Carol`, `Eric`, `Bob`, `Alice`, `Peter`
 - Each person has a unique birthday month: `feb`, `mar`, `sept`, `jan`, `may`, `april`
 - Everyone has something unique for lunch: `stew`, `soup`, `grilled cheese`, `stir fry`, `spaghetti`, `pizza`
 - People have unique heights: `very short`, `average`, `super tall`, `short`, `very tall`, `tall`
 - People own unique car models: `chevrolet silverado`, `ford f150`, `bmw 3 series`, `tesla model 3`, `toyota camry`, `honda civic`

## Clues:
1. The person who owns a Honda Civic is the person who is short.
2. The person who owns a Ford F-150 is in the fifth house.
3. The person who loves stir fry is somewhere to the left of Eric.
4. The person whose birthday is in May is somewhere to the left of Carol.
5. The person who is very short is somewhere to the left of the person whose birthday is in April.
6. The person who owns a BMW 3 Series is not in the third house.
7. There are two houses between the person who loves stir fry and the person who is a pizza lover.
8. The person who loves the soup is directly left of Eric.
9. The person who loves the spaghetti eater and the person whose birthday is in May are next to each other.
10. Alice is directly left of the person who owns a BMW 3 Series.
11. The person who owns a Tesla Model 3 is somewhere to the left of the person who is tall.
12. The person who is very tall is the person who owns a Toyota Camry.
13. Peter is directly left of the person who is a pizza lover.
14. The person who loves the stew is not in the third house.
15. There is one house between the person whose birthday is in September and the person who is very short.
16. There is one house between the person whose birthday is in March and the person who is super tall.
17. The person who is tall is Bob.
18. The person whose birthday is in May is somewhere to the right of Alice.
19. The person who is very short is in the fourth house.
20. The person whose birthday is in March is the person who is short.
21. Carol is the person who owns a Tesla Model 3.
22. Eric is the person whose birthday is in January.


Please output the solution in the following JSON format:
{"solution": {"header": ["House", "Name", "Birthday", "Food", "Height", "CarModel"], "rows": [["1", "Value1", "Value2", ...], ["2", "Value1", "Value2", ...]]}}

Below is one complete solution that meets all the clues:

• In this solution the six houses (from left‐to‐right, “1” to “6”) have these attributes:
 – House 1: Alice’s house. (Her birthday is in March, and she is “short” – and a “Honda Civic” owner – which fits the fact that the one who owns the Civic is the short person and the March‐birthday person.) Her lunch is “stir fry.”
 – House 2: Occupied by Arnold. His birthday is in September. He lives in the house with a “BMW 3 Series” (and note the clue “Alice is directly left of the person who owns a BMW 3 Series” makes House 1’s Alice immediately precede House 2). His lunch is “spaghetti” (and indeed the spaghetti lover is next to the one whose birthday is May, as explained below). His height is “average.”
 – House 3: Peter’s house. Peter’s birthday is in May. (This placement makes “May‐birthday” come immediately to the right of Alice’s house and to the left of Carol’s – see below.) He is “super tall” (since the clue “one house between the person whose birthday is in March and the person who is super tall” forces super tall to lie two houses from the March birthday in House 1). Here Peter eats “grilled cheese.” Furthermore, note that later “Peter is directly left of the person who is a pizza lover.”
 – House 4: Occupied by Carol. (Carol is given as the owner of a “Tesla Model 3” and must lie to the right of the May–birthday person [Clue 4]. Also, clue 19 fixes “very short” to house 4.) Carol’s birthday is in February. Her lunch is “pizza.” (Because then, by Clue 13, the person immediately to her left – namely, the resident of House 3 – is Peter.) 
 – House 5: This is Bob’s house. His birthday is in April. By Clue 2 the Ford F‑150 is in the fifth house. Also Bob is “tall” (and Clue 17 tells us “Bob is tall”). His lunch is “soup” (and because, by Clue 8, the soup–lover lives directly to the left of Eric – see next).
 – House 6: Occupied by Eric. His birthday is in January (Clue 22). Also, by Clue 8 the person who loves soup (in House 5) is directly to his left. In House 6 the car is a “Toyota Camry” (and Clue 12 tells us that the very tall person owns the Camry); so Eric is “very tall.” His lunch is “stew.”

A few of the clues are “relative‐position” ones. For example, since
 – Clue 10 (“Alice is directly left of the person who owns a BMW 3 Series”) forces House 1 to be Alice and House 2 to be the BMW owner,
 – Clue 16 (“There is one house between the person whose birthday is in March and the person who is super tall”) makes House 1 (with March–birthday) and House 3 (with super tall) match up,
 – Clue 7 (“There are two houses between the person who loves stir fry and the person who is a pizza lover”) is satisfied by placing “stir fry” in House 1 and “pizza” in House 4,
 – Clue 13 (“Peter is directly left of the person who is a pizza lover”) then forces Peter to be in House 3 (immediately left of the pizza–lover in House 4),
 – Clue 8 (“The person who loves soup is directly left of Eric”) together with assigning Eric to House 6 fixes House 5’s food as soup, and
 – the birthday “left–to–right” assignments (with March in House 1, September in House 2, May in House 3, February in House 4, April in House 5 and January in House 6) combine with Clues 4, 5, 15, and 18 to force the other names (and in particular to guarantee that Carol – who must own the Tesla – falls in House 4).

Also, note that the car–to–height links are observed:
 – The “Honda Civic” is owned by the short person (House 1, Alice),
 – The “BMW 3 Series” is not in House 3 (and it appears in House 2),
 – The “Ford F‑150” is in House 5,
 – Carol owns the “Tesla Model 3” (in House 4) and by Clue 11 her Tesla is somewhere to the left of the “tall” person (Bob), and
 – The “Toyota Camry” belongs to the very tall person (in House 6, Eric).

      ["4", "Carol", "feb", "pizza", "very short", "tesla model 3"],
